review_scope: Root source and exact insertion-diff review before the one authorized native replay; no numerical replay in this review.
findings: Per-iteration buffer reset precedes the original line-search loop.
Invalid trials are captured before the unchanged continue; valid paths are captured after their original merge and action evaluation.
The original Armijo acceptance expression and accepted/break statements remain unchanged.
Failure-only flush captures base, gradient and actual direction before the original failed-search history/break.
Base reevaluation occurs only after failure and affects no decision.
Evaluated step and post-loop halved step are separate; endpoint q values are zero and endpoint gradients blank.
The run requires all five original numerical CSVs byte-identical and both full-array in-process equality flags true.
limits: Neutrality and trial identities remain subject to the terminal replay checks.
No acceptance rule, production ray arithmetic or convergence flag is changed.
